rag.text:
Test: TC-5322 — Filtering panel - custom tab
Priority: Medium | Status: To Do | Type: Manual
Folder: /

Steps:
1. UNDER FF IntuitiveFilteringPanelEnabled

Navigate to Calendar module of boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-5322
   Expected: Calendar module of "TC-5322" is loaded. There are three tasks visible:

* Task 1 on 1/1/2025
* Task 2 on 15/1/2025
* Task 3 on 30/1/2025.
2. Open Filtering panel.
   Expected: Filtering Panel is opened.

There are 3 tabs:

* Quick Filters
* Custom
* Date Range.
3. Open "Custom" tab in the Filtering panel.
   Expected: "Custom" tab is opened.

There are two drop down lists visible.

There is an inactive "+ Add another" button and inactive "Clear custom filters" button.
4. Add filterOne
   Data: filerOne: Color is green
   Expected: Custom filter is applied. Task 1 and Task 2 are visible. 

There is an orange dot next to the Filters icon.

There is a blue number 1 next to "Custom" tab and "Filters".

"+ Add another" and "Clear custom filters" buttons are active.
5. Click "+ Add another".
   Expected: Two new dropdown windows are visible.

"+ Add another" button is inactive.

"Clear custom filters" button is active.
6. Add filterTwo
   Data: filterTwo: Assignee is admin
   Expected: Custom filter is applied. Task 1 is visible.

There is an orange dot next to the Filters icon.

There is a blue number 1 next to "Custom" tab and "Filters".

"+ Add another" and "Clear custom filters" buttons are active.
